name: ENGL 3120
title: Irish Literature in English to 1939
description: Fiction, drama, and poetry, including early Irish legends and sagas (in translation); such writers as Swift, Shaw, Wilde, Yeats, Gregory, Synge, Joyce, and Bowen. CA 4-INT.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; open to juniors or higher.
